files.description: CareCloud Charts v3.0 §170.315(b)(10) EHI Export Documentation. 11-page PDF containing: overview of export mechanisms (single-patient CCD, bulk CCD, PDF exports for billing/demographics/messages/documents, FHIR bulk export), step-by-step export instructions, and a detailed CCD data dictionary mapping data elements to CDA XPaths and code systems (SNOMED, ICD-10, LOINC, RxNorm, CVX, CPT-4, HCPCS, NDC). Authored by Rico Lopez, created 2023-11-14.

Screenshot of the Box shared link page showing the PDF viewer with page thumbnails, Download button, and CareCloud branding. Documents that the URL is accessible and the PDF renders correctly in the Box viewer.
